subject.title: Generate secretref reference docs from secret target registry metadata

question: Which open SecretRef docs-generation PR should be the canonical implementation path for this issue?
rationale: Current main still has the generated-doc gap, while two open conflicting PRs attempt overlapping fixes with different scope and proof signals.

options.title: Refresh stronger proven sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers want its formatter/test coverage refreshed onto current main.

options.title: Repair same-author PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91612 if maintainers prefer the issue author's smaller branch after it resolves conflicts and adds current-head proof.

options.title: Request one replacement
options.body: Close or pause both overlapping branches and ask for one narrow generator/check PR if neither branch is worth adopting.

recommendation.title: Refresh stronger proven sibling
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers want its formatter/test coverage refreshed onto current main.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the original SecretRef coverage PR and is the strongest available routing owner for choosing the canonical follow-up path.
